gloss_en: The blemish of the totality of the sinews (pegam kelaliyut ha-gidin) — the spiritual defect afflicting the collective network of the body's sinews/gidin, identified in Likutey Moharan I:29 as an aspect of the blemish of the covenant (pegam ha-brit) and of the blemish of the garments; the defect concerning the sinews as a whole, not the sinews themselves
